question: The total number of isomers of butane and pentane, respectively, are:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2,3.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Compounds with the **same chemical formula **but **distinct structural properties** are referred to as **isomers.**
 
• The total number of isomers of **butane is 2**.
 
 
• Butane has only two isomers, **n-butane and isobutane.**
 
 
 
• The total number of isomers of **pentane is 3**.
 
 
• Pentane has three isomers, **n-pentane, isopentane, and neopentane.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydrocarbon-based butane** is a highly **flammable, colorless, odorless**, and readily **liquefiable gas**.

 
 
• Usually, it is used as fuel for** portable stoves** and **cigarette lighters.**
 
• In addition, it finds application as a **refrigerant, heating fuel, propellant in aerosols**, and in numerous other manufacturing processes.
 
 
 
• **Pentane** is a **transparent, colorless liquid** that is an organic compound.
 
 
• **Pentane** has a smell that is reminiscent of **petroleum.**
 
• It is** insoluble in water** and has a **lower density than water. **
